uncertain: The 'Any LIFS courses at 3000/4000-level' and 'Any ECON/FINA/ISOM/MARK/MGMT courses at 3000/4000-level' entries are not specific courses but categories. They have been included as course entries with code like LIFS3000 and ECON3000 as placeholders, but these are not actual course codes. Human review is needed to determine how to represent these elective categories properly.

The total required credits for the major is not explicitly stated in the document. The sum of required course credits (22) and elective credits (9) is 31, but there may be additional requirements not captured in the extracted tables.

On page 2, there are several course listings with notes (e.g., CHEM, MATH, PHYS, ECON, LANG) that appear to be part of the major requirements but are not clearly grouped under a requirement header. It is uncertain whether these are additional required courses, electives, or prerequisites. These have not been included in the groups due to lack of clear grouping.

The note for LIFS 1901 on page 1 states: 'Note: Students with level 3 or above in HKDSE 1x Biology are exempted from taking LIFS 1901' with credits 0-3. This has been interpreted as a required course with possible exemption, but the exemption rule is not a course and has not been added as a separate course entry.

Similar exemption notes exist for CHEM 1008, MATH (multiple options), and PHYS (multiple options) on page 2. These have not been added as course entries because they represent choice or exemption rules, not definite course requirements.
The course MATH 1012 is noted as deleted on page 3, but it is still listed in the MATH choice note on page 2. This creates uncertainty about whether it should be considered available.

total_required_credits (31.0) is a computed value: the sum of the required_credits of all groups in this file.
